title: Migration storage budget
boundary: Limits apply to this original migration group. Raising them does not change per-file safety bounds, verify free disk space, or resume the task. Initial limits for received previews cannot be edited here.

phase.not_applicable: No tracked history storage in this batch.
phase.legacy_untracked: This older batch has no tracked group. No budget is created by viewing it.
phase.planned: Planned limits; the accounting group has not been created.
phase.active: The original accounting group exists. This does not mean the task is running.

usage: Committed {{bytes}} bytes · {{files}} files; pending reservations {{reserved}} bytes · {{reservedFiles}} files
margins: Required remaining space: {{bytes}} bytes / {{files}} file nodes. These are margins, not available space.
confirm: Type INCREASE to confirm this exact request
recovery: The full original request is saved on this client. A missing receipt does not prove it did not execute. Read it before explicitly resubmitting the same request.
unknown: No receipt observed for the original request; its execution is still unknown.
resumeSeparately: This receipt confirms only the increase. Use the separate Resume action if you want to continue the migration.
acknowledge: Acknowledge and keep local receipt selector
history: Recent request selectors on this client (up to 10)
terminal: This batch cannot accept a new increase in its current state. Existing receipts remain readable.

errors.readFailed: Unable to verify the budget. Read the original target again; no increase was inferred.
errors.increaseUnknown: The increase response is unconfirmed. Read its original receipt before deciding whether to resubmit.
errors.recoveryUnavailable: Local recovery storage is unavailable or invalid. No new increase can be sent.
errors.invalidLimits: Enter increased whole-number limits; free-space margins must stay unchanged.
errors.confirmationRequired: Review and explicitly confirm the current request.
errors.scopeChanged: The original target or account changed. Reopen its own migration record.
errors.jobNotMutable: The batch state changed; a new increase was not sent. Existing receipts remain readable.
errors.updateRequired: Update the target to use migration budgets.
errors.selectorChanged: Another page updated this job’s recovery selector. Its original request was preserved; read it before another action.

expired: The original policy revision {{previous}} is no longer acceptable (observed revision {{revision}}; no receipt for this original ID).
archiveBoundary: Save the complete old intent and its observation locally, then release this pending selector. This does not cancel or change the target. A new request needs a separate confirmation.
confirmArchive: Type ARCHIVE to save this expired intent locally
coordination: Recovery selectors use atomic browser metadata transactions across tabs, including ordinary HTTP. No network request runs inside that transaction.

initial.title: Initial history storage budget
initial.boundary: Use the target defaults unless you explicitly choose limits. These editable values are not available disk capacity. The original creation intent keeps its limits; later increases are separate confirmed requests. Per-file safety limits still apply.
initial.custom: Set limits for this new operation
initial.minFreeFileNodes: Required free file nodes (platform observation may be unknown)
initial.invalid: Enter supported non-negative integers. Total bytes and file count must be positive; free space must be at least 1 MiB.
initial.createdBoundary: This creation identity is fixed. Read its original receipt before any further action; creation does not publish or start the archive.

historyBoundary: The original archive or parent batch owns this accounting group. Reading and increasing its quota does not start work, undo cancellation or publish settings. Legacy tasks bind a budget only through an explicit recovery.
parentOwner: Controlled by original parent batch {{id}}. Change its budget from that batch.

attachment.title: Bind storage accounting for an older record
attachment.boundary: Viewing does not create a budget. BIND attaches only the original archive or parent group; it does not start work, undo cancellation or publish settings. A lost response must be checked against the original intent.
attachment.review: Review initial limits for this old record
attachment.restore: Review and finish the original binding
attachment.confirm: Type BIND to confirm this exact accounting intent
attachment.unconfirmed: This client saved an unconfirmed original intent. The target has not confirmed a binding; only an explicit retry of that unchanged intent is allowed.
attachment.formBoundary: Choose limits for this original record. They will become immutable initial limits for its shared accounting group; available disk space is still checked by the target.
attachment.custom: Set initial limits for this original record

phase.untracked: No binding intent or accounting group was observed for this original record.
phase.pending: The original binding intent exists. Its completion is still pending; do not create a new intent.
phase.attached: The original upgrade intent and all group bindings are verified. This does not prove task execution or publication.
phase.tracked: The original group is already tracked; no legacy upgrade receipt was inferred.
phase.parent_owned: The original parent batch controls this archive’s accounting.
phase.unknown: Original binding proof is incomplete or damaged. No budget was repaired or created.

errors.attachment_outcome_unknown: The binding result is unconfirmed. Read the original record before taking another action.
errors.attachment_intent_changed: The original intent or current record changed. Re-read it; no replacement intent was sent.
errors.attachment_confirmation_required: Review the full original intent and explicitly confirm BIND.
errors.attachment_recovery_unavailable: Recovery storage is unavailable or invalid. No binding was sent.
errors.attachment_invalid_response: The original binding response could not be verified. No success was inferred.
errors.attachment_update_required: Update the target to inspect old-record accounting.
